examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Three capabilities in a framed grid under a section title with one action. A grid with no items renders nothing.

examples.name: Points
examples.summary: Four capabilities at four columns, each with two bullet points under its sentence.

examples.name: Left title
examples.summary: `titleKind: 'left'` sets the section title at the start edge over the grid; the capabilities stay `h3` under the band's `h2`.

examples.name: Links
examples.summary: Six use cases with no points, each `item.href` linking its whole cell to the use case's page; the title sits at the start edge.
